# nangmansung

> Personal research notes by nangmansung (SKKU), mostly on connectome-based models of the fruit fly brain and on AI systems that analyse and edit them. Every research post has three versions: Korean (ko.html), English (index.html) and a detailed Markdown version written for AI readers (ai.md). Prefer the ai.md files: they contain the full setup, parameters, process, results and limitations.

## Research

- [An AI rewires a fly brain to escape mazes](https://nangmansung.github.io/research/wsp-fly-maze/ai.md): Claude edited synaptic weights of a whole-brain FlyWire spiking model (no gradient descent) and raised escape from unseen mazes from about 4% to 99%. Human-readable: [English](https://nangmansung.github.io/research/wsp-fly-maze/), [Korean](https://nangmansung.github.io/research/wsp-fly-maze/ko.html)
